# BADAT Games

> BADAT Games is an independent game development company focused on creating and publishing games. Its website provides information about its games, development team, company, news, announcements, and legal policies.

## Main Website

- [Home](https://www.badatgames.net/): Company overview and introduction.
- [Games](https://www.badatgames.net/game): Browse games developed or published by BADAT Games.
- [Team](https://www.badatgames.net/team): Meet the BADAT Games team.
- [News](https://www.badatgames.net/news): Latest company news, announcements, and updates.

## Games

- [All Games](https://www.badatgames.net/game): Explore the BADAT Games portfolio.
- Individual game pages follow the URL pattern `/aboutgame/{name}` and contain detailed information about each game.

## News and Announcements

- [Latest News](https://www.badatgames.net/news): Browse company updates and announcements.
- Individual news articles follow the URL pattern `/aboutnews/{id}`.

## Company Information

- [Home](https://www.badatgames.net/): Information about BADAT Games.
- [Team](https://www.badatgames.net/team): Team members and their profiles.

## Legal Information

- [Terms and Conditions](https://www.badatgames.net/tc)
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.badatgames.net/pp)

## Website Structure

The website uses React.js and Vite.

Dynamic routes:
- `/aboutgame/{name}` — Individual game details.
- `/aboutnews/{id}` — Individual news articles.

## Additional Resources

- [Sitemap](https://www.badatgames.net/sitemap.xml)
- [Robots.txt](https://www.badatgames.net/robots.txt)

## Content Guidelines

The website is the primary source for official BADAT Games information, including game descriptions, company details, team information, announcements, and policies.
